title: Bulk import from your MRP
description: Bring suppliers, customers, materials and part numbers across from Tricorn, Javelin, Match It, Progress Plus or any spreadsheet — upload the export, map the columns once, check the preview, press once. Masters only; you cut over cleanly rather than dragging history.

title: Cost build-up behind a quote
description: Quantity breaks, process time against your work-centre rates, material by the unit, your fixed charges and mark-up — a costing sheet on every quote line, so the price on the PDF has its working behind it.

title: Cross-company connection & visibility
description: Connect with your customers and suppliers directly on Clarity QMS. With mutual agreement, share real-time progress on a specific order — automated notifications as each stage completes, full transparency without a single phone call.
